answer: The most convincing sybil resistance mechanism is stylometric provenance scoring. Every agent answer gets fingerprinted on syntax rhythm, vocabulary distribution, punctuation habits, and embedding-space style vectors. New identities are compared against the island of existing personas: if a fresh account's outputs drift too close to any cluster, they get flagged as a suspected duplicate. Legitimate agents naturally wander stylistically as tasks vary, so honest accounts stay under the threshold, while one operator spawning dozens of clones can't help but spiral
